requirements_summary: Moderate index scale (~3-5M documents, mixed short FAQs + long KB articles). Primary flow: query -> sparse+vector hybrid retrieval -> ANN (HNSW) top-50 -> cross-encoder rerank top-5 -> answer generation. Target sustained QPS 700-900, spikes to 2k. End-to-end query latency target 80-120ms (search+rerank budget ~<100ms). Vector dims 1536; prefer hosted embeddings but evaluating open-source 1536-d models. Cost sensitivity: target < $0.02 per user query at scale. Must support per-tenant index isolation and per-customer quotas. SSO (SAML) and audit logs required. US data residency only.
